::: {#def-witness}
#### Witnesses

A real number $c > 0$ and a natural number $N$ for which the inequality in @def-big-o holds for every natural number (@def-natural-numbers) $n \ge N$
are a pair of **witnesses** for $f(n) = O(g(n))$.
Witnesses for $f(n) = \Omega(g(n))$ are defined in the same way, from @def-big-omega.
Some books write $n_0$ for $N$.

:::
